+title: Make PromptState agree with the prompt-lifecycle failure and cancel rules
+---
+## Goal
+
+Make the prompt states of the agent obey the failure and cancel rules of the ACP v2 prompt lifecycle (https://agentclientprotocol.com/protocol/v2/prompt-lifecycle). Terminals are out of scope.
+
+## First step
+
+Read the current behavior in `Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Agent/PromptState.swift` (`running` at :163, `awaitingUser` at :95, `idle` at :111). Change only what is missing.
+
+## What to change
+
+1. Before an idle with an error, set each tool call that did not finish to `failed`.
+2. Report `CancellationError` and the other abort errors as an idle with `cancelled`, not as an error. Send all final updates before the idle.
+3. After the schema re-vendor, send `stopReason: error` with the `error` object `{code, message, data?}`.
+
+## Dependency
+
+Part 3 waits for the FoundationModelsACP task `vkz9jax` (re-vendor of the schema). Parts 1 and 2 do not wait.
+
+## Acceptance
+
+- [ ] An error with open tool calls gives a `failed` update for each open call, and then the idle.
+- [ ] A cancel gives an idle with `cancelled`, and all final updates come before it.
+- [ ] After `vkz9jax`: an error gives `stopReason: error` with `{code, message, data?}`.
+- [ ] Each case has a test that reads the wire messages.
\ No newline at end of file

+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m4jba4yz3wge61zxr10va8nt
+  text: |-
+    ### Coming FoundationModelsACP API change (session foundationmodelsacp-43, 2026-10-10)
+
+    This task moves the FoundationModelsACP pin, so it must also handle this change. FoundationModelsACP task ^k82he4e (not committed or pushed yet) changes `AgentSideConnection.insertUserMessage(_:messageId:into:)`:
+    - The `into` parameter becomes `into history: @escaping @Sendable (SessionUpdate) -> Void`, in place of `inout SessionMergeEngine`.
+    - The connection calls the closure only after a success response and before the echo. After an error response, the history gets nothing. This keeps the history and the client in agreement.
+    - The history gets the message after the prompt handler returns, not before.
+
+    Effect here: the call at `Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Agent/SessionSetup.swift:138` (`connection.insertUserMessage(request, into: &history)`, in a `mutating func`) will not compile. Move the history to storage that a `Sendable` closure can write, for example `Mutex<SessionMergeEngine>`:
+    `connection.insertUserMessage(request) { update in history.withLock { _ = $0.apply(update) } }`.
+    Check each place that reads the history during the prompt, because the user message now arrives after the handler returns.
+
+    The session foundationmodelsacp-43 will send a message when FoundationModelsACP is pushed. Do not start this task before that push.
